author: Tazz
body:
Hello

As you may remember, last year myself and BmB made a bunch of Community Events which stopped when I became Official. However, while we wait for Atlas, why not get another one done? Here I present to you, the second All Star Game!

What is this event?
Two teams handpicked by myself will go head to head on Static, for a few reasons. Mainly, to spread awareness of other maps, and most importantly cannons.

When is this event?
The event will take place on the 3rd th of September at 7PM BST. This time was chosen so US people can play as well as EU.
I am looking for Media's to stream - msg me on Skype. OfficialAvicus may or may not be used.

Who is playing?

(Thanks for the image LEGOCHE!)

Some of the best players on Avicus.

Thank you,

Tazz
